response.sql: WITH rating_counts AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.rental_id IS NOT NULL THEN f.film_id END) AS film_count FROM film AS f LEFT JOIN inventory AS i ON i.film_id = f.film_id LEFT JOIN rental AS r ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id GROUP BY f.rating), overall AS (SELECT AVG(film_count) AS avg_count FROM rating_counts) SELECT AVG(rc.film_count) AS average_film_count, AVG(rc.film_count - o.avg_count) AS average_excess FROM rating_counts AS rc CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE rc.film_count > o.avg_count;
